name: Arden work tools (dashboards and kiosk)
what: Andrew's tools for the Hubbell Arden distribution center: Arden Hub (one PIN-gated app for the floor: Shift, Pick, Pack, Stage, Ship, People, Improve, System), the Weekend Overtime kiosk (ardenot), Staging Lane Health and Arden Pack (run as modules inside the hub), the CI idea board, and the dashboard PC kit that feeds them from SAP exports.
where: Arden Hub: repo brenemanandrew/Arden-hub (PUBLIC), live https://arden-hub.fly.dev, deploys on push to main after tests
Overtime kiosk: repo brenemanandrew/ardenot (private), live https://ardenot.fly.dev
CI idea board: https://hubbellideaboard.fly.dev (own app, auto-stops, wakes on first hit)
Staging Lane Health source: F:\Projects\Staging Lane Health on the main PC; kits under Apps\Staging Lane Health on Drive
Agent memory notes: Hubbell\claude-memory on Google Drive
stack: Node standard library only, no dependencies (npm into a Drive folder corrupts node_modules)
One Fly machine each (--ha=false), data as files on one volume
SAP host PC pushes exports (WHTask.XLSX, Orders.XLSX, HU STAGING.XLSX, SAP Deliveries.TXT, SAP PGI.TXT)
Dashboard PC runs the roster sender and copier printer every 2 minutes

tools.name: Arden Hub
tools.what: Shift home with Pick, Pack, Stage, Ship cards; People and Packers over time; Improve; System health board with uptime, p50/p95, stale detection
tools.use_when: Any floor dashboard question or new view: add it here as a section or module, not as a new site

tools.name: Staging Lane Health (module /stage)
tools.what: Lane board, TV and phone views, pickers, packer performance (/stage/packers)
tools.use_when: Lanes, pick performance, packer lines per hour

tools.name: Arden Pack (module /pack)
tools.what: Pack board: units and lines off the benches, pace, bench by hour

tools.name: Weekend Overtime kiosk (ardenot)
tools.what: Sign-ups, draw with tickets and pick penalties, roster from the Cross Training Spreadsheet, posting sheets printed via the dashboard PC

tools.name: Dashboard PC kit (ardenot/dashboard-pc)
tools.what: Sends the roster when it changes, prints posting sheets to the copier from inside the network
tools.use_when: Anything that must reach inside the Hubbell network

tools.name: System board (lib/checker.js, dashboards.json)
tools.what: Checks every dashboard once a minute: down, stale, slow, up
tools.use_when: Adding monitoring for a new dashboard: add an entry to dashboards.json

settings.name: Kiosk draw rules (latest)
settings.value: tickets cap at 4, reset monthly; 4 tickets picked first in pool; pick penalty 10/20/30/40% for 1-4 picks in a row; tickets spent on first pick of the weekend

settings.name: Sign-in pattern
settings.value: one passphrase per device, 180-day signed cookie, 5 wrong per address = 15 min wait
